name: No Thanks! (Bounded Laps)
summary: Players pay one chip to refuse a card or take it with the pot. Each card may circle the table at most twice before it is burned. The lowest score, card points minus chips, wins.

player.meaning: Chips in hand. Only the owner sees this. Each chip lowers the final score by 1.
Card numbers this player has taken.
Sum of the lowest card of each run of consecutive numbers in the tableau, kept up to date on every take.

game.meaning: Undrawn cards. Hidden order; only the count is announced.
Cards removed unseen at setup. They stay hidden all game.
The card on offer; 0 means there is no card.
Chips paid onto the current card. They carry over after a burn.
Full laps in which every seat paid on the current card.
The seat that receives the first offer of the round.
Cards burned after 2 full laps. They score for no one; their count is announced.
Rounds played, used for the 40-round bound.

setup: Move 13 of them at random into the hidden table list `removed`; nobody ever sees them.
The remaining 20 cards form the hidden table list `deck`.
Each player gets chips = 11, an empty tableau and card_points = 0.
Set current_card = 0, pot = 0, lap_count = 0, lead_seat = 1, burned = [] and round_number = 0.
Seats are numbered 1 to N clockwise.
Sync each player their own state, including their private chip count.

round.effect: round_number += 1. When current_card = 0 and deck is not empty: draw one card at random from deck (remove it from deck), set current_card to it and set lap_count = 0. The pot is unchanged.
Announce current_card, pot, every player's tableau and card_points, the length of deck and the length of burned.

round.answer: TAKE, or PAY if that seat has chips >= 1
round.effect: When current_card != 0. PAY: chips -= 1 and pot += 1. TAKE: append current_card to tableau; card_points += c, minus (c+1) if c+1 is in the tableau, minus c if c-1 is in the tableau; chips += pot; pot = 0; lead_seat = this seat; current_card = 0.
Same as offer 1. Runs only when current_card != 0.
Same as offer 1. Runs only when current_card != 0.
Same as offer 1. Runs only when current_card != 0 and N >= 4.

End of lap, when current_card != 0: lap_count += 1. If lap_count = 2: append current_card to burned, set current_card = 0, keep pot, and set lead_seat = (lead_seat mod N) + 1. If lap_count = 1, nothing else changes.
Announce who paid and who took, or that the card was burned. Then sync each player their own chips privately.
End the game if deck is empty and current_card = 0, or if round_number >= 40. Otherwise continue.

ending.decided_by: A player's final score is card_points minus chips, and lower is better, so each player is ranked by chips minus card_points. The highest value (the lowest final score) wins. Players level at the top share the win, which stands in for the source's draw.

rules.text: When the game is set up, the deck holds 20 distinct cards from 3..35 and the other 13 sit in the hidden removed list.
When the game starts, each player has chips = 11, an empty tableau and card_points = 0; chips are visible only to their owner.
When the game starts, current_card = 0, pot = 0, lap_count = 0, lead_seat = 1 and burned is empty.
When a round starts with current_card = 0 and a non-empty deck, then one card moves from deck to current_card, lap_count becomes 0 and the pot is unchanged.
When a round starts with current_card != 0, then no card is drawn and the same card and pot continue.
When an offer is made, then the seat is offered TAKE, and also PAY only if its chips >= 1.
When a seat PAYs, then its chips fall by 1 and the pot rises by 1.
When a seat TAKEs card c, then c is appended to its tableau and card_points changes by c, minus (c+1) if c+1 was already held, minus c if c-1 was already held.
When a seat TAKEs, then its chips rise by the pot, the pot becomes 0, current_card becomes 0, lead_seat becomes that seat, and no further offers are made that round.
When offer k is made, then it goes to the seat k-1 places clockwise from lead_seat, for k = 1..N, and only while current_card != 0.
When a seat with 0 chips is offered the card, then its only option is TAKE.
When all N seats pay in a round and lap_count becomes 1, then the card, pot and lead_seat stay the same for the next round.
When all N seats pay and lap_count becomes 2, then the card is appended to burned, current_card becomes 0, the pot is kept and lead_seat moves one seat clockwise.
When the deck is empty and current_card = 0 at the end check, then the game ends.
When 40 rounds have been played, then the game ends.
When the game ends, then each final score is card_points minus chips, and chips left in the pot belong to no one.
When the game ends, then the player with the lowest final score wins, and players tied for lowest share the result.

offers.question: Offer on the current card (offers 1 to N)
offers.who: the seat k-1 places clockwise from lead_seat, while current_card != 0
offers.options: a seat with chips >= 1: TAKE, PAY; a seat with chips = 0: TAKE

choices.why: The designer's count is kept. Three seats is the smallest table where pressing your luck against several rivals is tense. Four keeps each lap short and each refusal costly.
The rules contain no table talk. The strategy is when to pay to drive up the pot and when to take a card that extends a run; adding talk would add a mechanic.
Players level at the top share the win, which is the engine's form of the source's draw.
The final score depends on chips, so an outside observer must read them, though players see only their own.

simplifications.what: Lowest score wins, expressed as ranking by chips - card_points (highest wins)
simplifications.why: The engine ranks highest first, so the score is negated.

simplifications.what: card_points kept incrementally on each take instead of recomputed from runs
simplifications.why: The incremental formula in R5 equals the sum of the lowest cards of each run, and it is simple arithmetic.

simplifications.what: Four fixed offer steps, the fourth skipped when N = 3
simplifications.why: The step list is flat; each offer is one ask step with an arithmetic condition.
It enforces the 40-round bound stated in the rules.
